diagnosis: The endpoint authenticates that the caller is a registered patient, but performs a direct Elasticsearch client.get() lookup using the recordId path parameter. It fails to verify that response._source.patient_id matches req.user.patientId, allowing any authenticated patient to retrieve confidential medical histories, diagnoses, and lab results of any other patient in the index.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/health-records/enc_patient_0049182 HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.telehealth-care.org
Authorization: Bearer <patient_jwt>
